title: The First Walk Through Pine Park
synopsis: Pine Park opens, and the friends walk the completed path and read back Jack's notebook.
continuity_state: Before: work fence, finished gravel path and hill, sign awaiting installation. After: work fence removed, PINE PARK sign installed with friends' artwork, bench ready under original pine, and first public walk completed. Jack adds OUR FIRST WALK notebook page.
